|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/ifthetracewascorrect.html</ref>

On this ominous purple card depicting [[Maul]] and a [[Sith Probe Droid]] in deep conversation, the benefits for your Hunt The Queen strategy are provided. First, you can get your Sith Probe Droids out directly from Reserve. Besides a nice little retrieval text on those hunter-seeker droids, it also provides you with a way to search for the Queen without having to move [[Darth Maul]] away from a good drain site. Let the droid do the legwork!

'Trace' also provides you with another way to capture Amidala, above and beyond that provided on the partner Effect, [[I Will Find Them Quickly, Master]]. If forfeited at [[Maul]]'s site, Amidala is captured. That simple line stops your opponent from using a cheap way to remove her from your location.

The rest of this card provides you with benefits for capturing Amidala. Once seized, opponent's battle destinies are each reduced by 1, and a nice little "[[Beggar]]" style ability is provided, allowing you to use 3 Force from your opponent's Force Pile during your turn. This is a major blow to your opponent's Force saving and card drawing potential!

If you endeavour to take the captive Queen from [[Tatooine (Dark){{!}}Tatooine]], then two more benefits kick in, reducing all [[Tatooine (Dark){{!}}Tatooine]] site drains by 1 for opponent, and spoiling his tracking ability with a Reserve Deck shuffle every turn (that's after your turn and your opponents!).

All this can certainly provide a headache in a Light Side day!
